provenance.source: PR #5133 fix(request): fix multipart boundary mismatch in cloneRawRequest, squash-merged 2026-07-18
provenance.note: the clone re-serializes a FormData body, so every content header copied from the original request is stale, but the added block drops only the content type: the declared content length stays at the original body's byte count (77 for a 169-byte clone), and a request built from the clone would send a truncated body; the base kept both stale headers, so this PR fixed the boundary half and left the length half (fix PR #5282)

bugs.note: the block removes the stale content type because the runtime regenerates the multipart boundary, and leaves the stale content length, which the regeneration also invalidates; the fix deletes the content length in the same branch
